title: Judgment on Babylon

questions.question: Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of whom?
Sit on the ground without a throne, O daughter of the whom?
For you shall no more be called tender and what?
Our Redeemer—the LORD of hosts is his name—is the Holy One of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 47:4 (ESV): "is the Holy One of Israel."

questions.question: Sit in silence, and go into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans; for you shall no more be called the mistress of what?
I was angry with my people; I profaned my heritage; I gave them into your hand; you showed them no what?
On the aged you made your yoke exceedingly what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 47:6 (ESV): "On the aged you made your yoke exceedingly heavy."

questions.question: You said, "I shall be mistress forever," so that you did not lay these things to heart or remember their what?
Now therefore hear this, you lover of pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me; I shall not sit as a widow or know the loss of what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 47:8 (ESV): "or know the loss of children":

questions.question: These two things shall come to you in a moment, in one day; the loss of children and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 47:9 (ESV): "the loss of children and widowhood;"

questions.question: You felt secure in your wickedness; you said, "No one sees me"; your wisdom and your knowledge led you what?
But evil shall come upon you, which you will not know how to charm away; disaster shall fall upon you, for which you will not be able to what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 47:11 (ESV): "for which you will not be able to atone;"

questions.question: Stand fast in your enchantments and your many sorceries, with which you have labored from your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 47:12 (ESV): "with which you have labored from your youth;"

questions.question: Let your astrologers... stand up and save you... Behold, they are like what?
The fire consumes them; they cannot deliver themselves from the power of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 47:14 (ESV): "from the power of the flame."

key_verse_text: Our Redeemer—the LORD of hosts is his name—is the Holy One of Israel.
